description: The structured output one group reviewer returns in the Build 6 review fan-out. Each reviewer runs with claude -p --json-schema against this schema, and scripts/check_fanout.py validates every stored run record against it, so the schema is load bearing and not decorative.

evidence.description: Packet paths the finding rests on. Every entry must stand in the manifest file list.

id.description: Stable within the run, unique across the merged set.

file.description: A path from the packet manifest file list.

rule.description: The review rule the finding claims is violated. Part of the dedupe identity.

group.description: The file group id this reviewer covered, matching the run record.

verdict.description: fail when the findings list is non empty, pass when it is empty.

title: Recognitio review fan-out group findings
